title: Item Search — Product Groups: a single match reads '1 product groups found' (plural noun for a count of one)
requirementSource: No ticket names the count label's wording. Filed as a cosmetic grammar defect on a label every search renders; the Products page's sibling label was not checked for the same count.
stepsToReproduce: Open Item Search -> Product Groups on the e2e environment (office 1101).
Type the full name 'ZZ E2E Group 1788335968232' into the search box, pause, and press Enter.
Read the count label above the grid -> '1 product groups found' with exactly one row.
Search 'Group 1788335968232' (a phrase inside that one name) -> the same '1 product groups found'.
expectedBehavior: A count of one reads '1 product group found'; the noun agrees with the number.
actualBehavior: The label always uses the plural: '1 product groups found'.

mcpEvidence.findings: Read live on the e2e environment, office 1101, through headless Playwright with the suite's saved sign-in: two single-match terms both rendered '1 product groups found' (machine output .playwright-cli/pgr-2026-09-09/probes-search-matrix.json, rows 'Group 1788335968232' and 'ZZ E2E Group 1788335968232').

notes: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-10 by owner ruling: accepted behaviour, not a defect. TC-ISR-PGR-014 is unchanged: it asserts the number and the single row, not the wording of the label. History preserved: Severity assessed low: cosmetic. TC-ISR-PGR-014 asserts the number and the row, not the wording, so it stays green; tighten it to the singular once the label is fixed.
